title: The fibres of an etale morphism are disjoint unions of spectra of finite separable field extensions
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be an etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism], let $s\in S$ with residue field $\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-residue-field], and let $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ be the fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Then $X_s$ is a disjoint union of spectra of finite separable field extensions of $\kappa(s)$: the underlying topological space of $X_s$ is discrete (every point of $X_s$ is open and closed in $X_s$), and for every point $y\in X_s$ the open subscheme $\{y\}$ [def-pc-scheme] of $X_s$ is isomorphic over $\kappa(s)$ to $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(y)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], where the residue field $\kappa(y)$ is a finite field extension [def-pc-field-extension] of $\kappa(s)$ every element of which is a root of a separable polynomial over $\kappa(s)$ [def-pc-separable-polynomial].

proof.text: Write F for the fibre and p for its projection to Spec kappa(s). The projection is etale by Mathlib Sites.EtalePoint, so the proved source theorem p.etale_residueFieldMap y makes Spec of its residue-field map etale. The canonical residue-field map into Spec kappa(s) is an isomorphism: it is a surjective closed immersion with reduced target, by Mathlib isClosed_singleton_iff_isClosedImmersion and isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective. Residue-field naturality identifies the composite of these two maps with F.fromSpecResidueField y followed by p. By composition it is etale. Spec.homEquiv.symm_apply_apply identifies this composite with Spec.map i, for exactly the i in the statement.

proof.text: The fibre is reduced by the proved source isReduced_of_etale applied to p. Let U be the open singleton {y}, open because the fibre is discrete. Lift g = F.fromSpecResidueField y through U.ι using IsOpenImmersion.lift and its range identity. The lift l is a preimmersion by cancellation, surjective since every point of U equals y, and a closed immersion because its range is closed in the discrete U. U is reduced, so Mathlib isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective makes l an isomorphism. Set e = (asIso l).symm. Replacing Spec.map i by g followed by p, and g by l followed by U.ι, the required equation follows from inv l followed by l being the identity.

lean.statement: theorem Scheme.Hom.etale_fibre_discrete_separable_points {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Etale f] (s : S) : DiscreteTopology (f.fiber s) ∧ ∀ y : f.fiber s, let i := Spec.homEquiv ((f.fiber s).fromSpecResidueField y ≫ f.fiberToSpecResidueField s) letI := i.hom.toAlgebra Module.Finite (S.residueField s) ((f.fiber s).residueField y) ∧ (∀ a : (f.fiber s).residueField y, ∃ p : Polynomial (S.residueField s), p.Separable ∧ Polynomial.aeval a p = 0) ∧ ∃ U : (f.fiber s).Opens, (U : Set (f.fiber s)) = {y} ∧ ∃ e : U.toScheme ≅ Spec ((f.fiber s).residueField y), e.hom ≫ Spec.map i = U.ι ≫ f.fiberToSpecResidueField s
